item.title: River Valley condos combine centrality, demand and relative affordability
item.description: Singapore is divided into 55 planning areas, which are further grouped into five regions. item.title: Mitsubishi Estate Asia puts 49.9% stake in Australian land lease venture up for sale
item.description: Mitsubishi Estate Asia (MEA) is looking to sell its stake in a portfolio of land lease communities in Australia. A land lease community refers to a residential development where the ownership of the home is separated from the land it occupies. Residents own their home but lease the land from the community operator, allowing for lower upfront costs. In Australia, the model is primarily adopted for housing targeted at seniors and retirees. item.title: Over 9,000 flats launched for sale in February BTO and SBF exercises
item.description: HDB has launched 9,012 flats for sale under the February Build-To-Order (BTO) flats and Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercises. A total of 4,692 BTO flats are up for sale across six projects in Bukit Merah, Sembawang, Tampines and Toa Payoh, along with 4,320 balance flats, located islandwide. item.title: PropNex, ERA being sued again, in $367k and $731k lawsuits linked to property deals
item.description: Two of Singapore’s largest real estate agencies, PropNex Realty and ERA Realty Network, are each facing lawsuits relating to property deals again.
